Container.Name: X-ONU-SFPP-Dashboard
Container.Overview:
A lightweight monitoring and alerting dashboard for EXEN X-ONU-SFPP and compatible ONTs running 8311 community firmware.
Core monitoring uses the 8311 JSON metrics endpoint to provide live and historical optical levels, temperatures, PLOAM state, connectivity, and profile-aware optical health without requiring SSH.
Optional SSH telemetry adds live XGS-PON traffic rates, byte counters, FEC/BIP/HEC/MIC statistics, active alarms, ONT system information, and optical module details.
Server-side alert monitoring provides configurable thresholds, severities, debounce behavior, counter-delta detection, and cooldowns. Alerts are stored in SQLite and continue to be evaluated even when the dashboard is not open.
Notifications are supported through Discord, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, and Generic Webhook.
Telemetry and alert-history retention are configurable from the dashboard. Recent alerts are shown directly on the main dashboard, with a dedicated paginated Alert History view for retained events.
The dashboard also supports light, dark, and system themes.
The Unraid host must have network access to the ONT management IP. SSH access is optional and is required only for advanced telemetry.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: XGS-PON XGSPON ONU ONT 8311 EXEN X-ONU-SFPP PON fiber optical monitoring
Container.Requires:
An EXEN X-ONU-SFPP or compatible ONT running 8311 community firmware with the JSON metrics endpoint enabled. The Unraid server must be able to reach the ONT management IP. SSH access to the ONT is optional and is required only for advanced telemetry.
Existing installations upgraded from older root-running versions may have root-owned application data. If the container cannot write to its existing database after upgrading, run this one-time command on the Unraid host if using the default appdata path:
chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/x-onu-dashboard
Fresh installations require no permission changes.
Container.Changes:
v3.4.0 - Added optional dashboard authentication and configurable ONT TLS verification. Hardened notification delivery against SSRF, bounded notification backlog and alert-history pagination, persisted alert runtime state across restarts, rebaselined alert state after policy changes, and added browser security headers. Improved telemetry validation, retention failure handling, SQLite history downsampling and connection cleanup, build/dependency reproducibility, Docker build hygiene, and container health checks.
v3.3.0 - Added light, dark, and system themes, developer documentation, alert-config-driven dashboard health thresholds, and profile-aware TX optical health. Added the XGSPONST2001 A-01 profile using the documented 4.00-9.00 dBm XGS-PON operating envelope while preserving Legacy and Custom threshold modes.
v3.2.0 - Added configurable telemetry retention, paginated alert history, notification credential hardening, persistent SSH host-key verification, and debounce handling for core telemetry reachability alerts.
v3.1.0 - Added notification providers and the alert settings page, documented alert configuration, and improved recent-alert presentation.
v3.0.1 - Improved alert settings and alert-history layout.
v3.0.0 - Initial public v3 release.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port used to access the X-ONU-SFPP Dashboard.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite metrics database.

Config.Name: ONT Metrics URL
Config.Description: URL of the 8311 JSON metrics endpoint.

Config.Name: Polling Interval
Config.Description: Number of seconds between core ONT metric requests.

Config.Name: Enable Advanced SSH Telemetry
Config.Description: Enable optional SSH-based advanced telemetry. Core monitoring works without SSH.

Config.Name: SSH Host
Config.Description: Management IP or hostname of the ONT used for advanced SSH telemetry.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: SSH port used for advanced telemetry.

Config.Name: SSH Username
Config.Description: SSH username used for advanced telemetry.

Config.Name: SSH Password
Config.Description: SSH password used for advanced telemetry. The value is passed to the container as a Docker environment variable and can be inspected by users with Docker or Unraid host access.

Config.Name: SSH Polling Interval
Config.Description: Number of seconds between advanced SSH telemetry collection cycles.

Config.Name: SSH Command Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for advanced telemetry commands.

Config.Name: Request Timeout
Config.Description: Timeout in seconds when requesting metrics from the ONT.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Container directory used for persistent dashboard data. Normally this should remain /data.
